# Miguel RC — Data Science & Software Engineering Portfolio

> Portfolio and blog of Miguel RC: applied machine learning and data science
> projects, each published as a fully rendered, self-contained site with
> notebooks, methodology, results and honest limitations. All content is
> public and free to crawl, index and cite.

The hub (this site) lists every project; each project lives at its own
subpath on this host with its own pages and sitemap. Source code for every
project is on GitHub at https://github.com/migue-rc.

## Site

- [Home](https://migue-rc.github.io/index.html): project gallery with descriptions and categories
- [About](https://migue-rc.github.io/about.html): bio, education and GitHub activity

## Projects

- [FIFA World Cup 2026 Predictor](https://migue-rc.github.io/fwc2026/): live
  experiment predicting every round of the 2026 World Cup as it happens - one
  Poisson regression per national team plus a tuned player-quality layer,
  scored against reality after every round
- [Student Performance Analysis](https://migue-rc.github.io/student-performance/):
  end-to-end regression pipeline (data prep, EDA, modeling, conclusions)
  predicting exam performance
- [Lung Cancer Risk Predictor](https://migue-rc.github.io/lung-cancer-risk/):
  L1-regularized logistic regression served as an interactive in-browser risk
  estimator, with full modeling notebook
- [Car Insurance & Telematics Analytics](https://migue-rc.github.io/car-insurance/):
  claim prediction and driver-risk labeling from telematics data with
  gradient-boosting models and clustering
- [Aggressive Dogs Don't Bite (Or Do They?)](https://migue-rc.github.io/EDA_dogs/):
  exploratory analysis of dog-bite reports - a case study in base-rate fallacy
- [Linear Regression from Scratch](https://migue-rc.github.io/FS-linear-regression/):
  the algorithm derived and implemented with NumPy only, with animated visuals
- [Logistic Regression from Scratch](https://migue-rc.github.io/FS-logistic-regression/):
  companion deep dive on logistic regression, also NumPy-only
